MOZ.note: Training is for youth and startups, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The communications and digital transformation ministry's permanent secretary visited the Nampula technology incubator on 9 July 2026, which trained about 1,300 young people and startups in the first half of 2026, including 140 girls in Coding Girl; all figures are from one province.

Incubator support and symbolic licences for startups are named, but no startup act, strategy, label or public fund is stated.

facts.fact: The ATDI technology and inclusive incubator in Nampula runs a 45-day pre-incubation programme with a current cohort of seven startups, and has supported 66 startups from four hackathons (33 pre-incubation, 13 incubation, 20 acceleration), while the Tech Hub building is being rehabilitated.
